resources.string: We start by forming a Daisy — a plus sign of white edge pieces around the yellow center.
Once you\'ve moved all the white edge pieces to the top, you\'ll see something like this. (You can ignore the adjacent colors for now.)
If you see a white edge piece in the bottom layer, clear any white edges from the top using U moves, then move it to the top with F2.
If the white edge is on a side and paired with another white, rotate upper layer to empty the top, then insert that piece into the daisy. (U\' R in this image)
If the white edge is twisted in the top or bottom layer, move it to the side with F or F\' — it will become Case 2.
